Served-recipe 27B np4 serving-floor calibration (W1S), A/A on the C21 GPU store. Row identity, workload and recipe come from row_config.json.

scatter IS the floor; unit = process: one launch = one fresh server = one sample).

PRE-REGISTERED (before any run):
MODEL     W1S = Qwen3.8-27B Q8_0 + DFlash2 drafter (draft-dflash, n-max 7), ROCm0, np 4, ctx 393216, q8_0 K/V, --kv-unified, -b 512 -ub 512,
          -t 8 -ngl 99 -ngld 99 -fa on, --no-mmap --ctx-checkpoints 32 --cache-ram 65536 --no-cache-idle-slots --jinja --reasoning off
          (exact argv: gpu_common.recipe_args('W1S'); shape = 8 host threads 184-191, numactl --membind=3, HSA_OVERRIDE_CPU_AFFINITY_DEBUG=0).
STORE     /mnt/raid0/llm/kernels/builds/gpu-20261124-98ff8a42a-c21 (C21, source 98ff8a42a00ce816522fc913bbcfc414fe850d54; BUILD-OK and
          BUILD-IDENTITY both bound to that sha) in BOTH arms, no knob. C21 is the served kernel's experimental equivalent (the champion tip
          the served recipe runs on), not the frozen production tree.
QUESTION  What are the screen floor and the serving floor of the served 27B np4 aggregate_tok_s instrument on the C21 GPU store, quiet host,
          unit=process, 95 % interval at n = 24 independent A/A pairs (FLOOR-UNIT-1)?
SUFFICIENCY n = 24 pairs per FLOOR-UNIT-1 / INF-73 s8.9. Expected launch CV from the W1 floor: 3.83 % -> SD(ln ratio) ~ sqrt(2)*3.83 % = 5.4 %
          -> serving floor half-width t(23)*SD/sqrt(24) ~ 2.07*5.4/4.9 ~ 1.6 % (screen floor ~ 10.6 %). The floor is the answer; no effect
          is being tested, so there is no power target beyond the pre-registered n.
INPUTS    the store; the model files (size-pinned); a ~4k-token prompt. Any missing input = FUTILITY_MISSING_INPUT (nothing measured, rc 0).
STEPS     48 launches = 24 balanced pairs (seeded AB/BA, seed from row_config). Launch: fresh llama-server (own-port proof, own-pid KFD VRAM
          >= residency floor and libggml-hip mapped from the store), one discarded warm-up request, then ONE measured round of 4 CONCURRENT
          requests (one per slot; same 4k prompt, cache_prompt false, distinct fixed per-slot seeds SLOT_SEEDS, served sampling temperature
          1.0 top_p 0.95 top_k 20, n_predict 384, ignore_eos), reap. Metric: aggregate_tok_s = sum(predicted_n) / wall of the round (first
          request sent -> last response received). Also recorded: per-request tok/s (1000 * predicted_n / predicted_ms) and draft acceptance
          (sum draft_n_accepted / sum draft_n). Contention label per launch = host busy % on 184-191 minus the server's own ticks (+ foreign
          KFD pids with >= 64 MiB VRAM) over the round window.
VALID     a launch is valid iff started, resident, reaped, and every one of the 4 requests has predicted_n == 384 and the same prompt_n
          (within 2500..6500, equal to the row's reference prompt_n).
RULE      Per pair x_k = ln(agg(B) / agg(A)). CALIBRATED iff 24 valid pairs and every launch's foreign busy p95 <= 15 % and no foreign KFD
          pid; CALIBRATED_CONTENDED when only the contention clause fails (floor filed with the co-tenant label). Records: n, mean(x) with
          95 % t interval, SD(x) with 95 % chi-square interval, screen floor = 1.96 * SD(x), serving floor = t(23) * SD(x) / sqrt(24),
          per-launch CV and unit=process. No kernel, quality or promotion claim. Gate-class: futility-only.
STOP      on-answer: 24 valid pairs -> RESULT.json. on-futility: missing input (FUTILITY_MISSING_INPUT, rc 0), wrong grant
          (FUTILITY_WRONG_GRANT, live run only), unproven residency (FUTILITY_RESIDENCY), more than 8 invalid launches
          (FUTILITY_INVALID_LAUNCHES), and ONE interim futility-only look after 8 valid pairs (16 launches): launch CV of aggregate_tok_s
          > 15 % -> FUTILITY_NOISE (a floor that wide cannot gate anything). STOP file / FILLER_DEADLINE: rc 75 only, resumable per launch.
SMOKE     FILLER_SMOKE=1 / FILLER_DRYRUN=1: ONE real scored unit: a real launch of the served recipe (ctx 32768, np 4, honours WS58_REGIONS),
          warm-up, the 4-concurrent round at n_predict 32 -> out-smoke/RESULT.json SMOKE_OK and out-smoke/smoke_measure.json.
